answer_2.quote: We employed the UTMOS model to automatically predict MOS scores, providing an objective measure of speech quality. To evaluate the pronunciation accuracy of synthesized speech, we used automatic speech recognition (ASR) models, specifically Whisper and wav2vec 2.0, to calculate word error rate (WER) and phoneme error rate (PER). ... we extracted speaker embeddings using WavLM-base-plus ... and computed speaker embedding similarity (SIM).

answer_3.quote: The scoring process for all tasks takes into account factors such as naturalness, contextual relevance, fluency, and overall suitability for speech interaction, providing a comprehensive assessment of the model's performance. ... we leverage GPT-4o for this assessment.

answer_4.quote: We conducted a mean opinion score (MOS) test and a similarity mean opinion score (sMOS) test. In the MOS test, evaluators rated the naturalness of the speech on a 5-point scale (1 to 5), while in the sMOS test, they assessed how similar the synthesized speech was to the target speech on the same scale. We also conducted filler naturalness MOS (fMOS) and filler style controllability MOS (cMOS) evaluations to assess the naturalness of filler segments and the effectiveness of filler style control.
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators rated each sample on a 5-point scale for naturalness, speaker similarity, filler naturalness, and filler style controllability.
